<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-283" status="finalized">de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen pa</rs><abbr>'i</abbr> zhal <lb n="63b8"/> mnga' nas kyang | 
                  <quote source="db:5564" n="IX (ad IX.40ab)"><!--T262-->de ltar grub mtha' 4 las <abbr>slob dpon ni</abbr> <abbr>phyi rol</abbr> gyi don <abbr>khas len</abbr> <abbr>pa'i</abbr> tshe <abbr>mdo sde</abbr> pa ltar mdzad la | 
                  <abbr>shes bya</abbr> nang la 'jug pa na <abbr>rnam med</abbr> zhal gyis <abbr>bzhes so</abbr> |</quote> 
                  <abbr>zhes gsung ngo</abbr> | 
                  ci ste 'dir yang | 
                  <quote source="db:3772" n="III.360">gang gis <abbr>dngos po</abbr> rnam dpyad na ||</quote> zhes 1 dang du bral gyi <abbr>gtan tshigs</abbr> <abbr>gsung</abbr> pa <abbr>min nam</abbr> zhe na | 
                  <abbr>gsung</abbr> mod kyi | des ni <abbr>dngos po</abbr> mtha' dag <abbr>rang bzhin</abbr> <abbr>med par</abbr> <pb n="64a"/><lb n="64a1"/> gtan la 'bebs pa ma <abbr>yin no</abbr> || </seg></TEI>
